# Takshasheela School of Civil Services - Comprehensive Knowledge & Course Information

> **Takshasheela School of Civil Services** (formerly registered and known as **Takshashila School of Civil Services**) is a premier civil services coaching institute in Guwahati, Assam, India. The institute operates as an educational unit of **Takshashila Educational Trust** (Parent Company), delivering national-standard preparation for UPSC (Union Public Service Commission), APSC (Assam Public Service Commission), and ADRE (Assam Direct Recruitment Examination).

---

## 1. Overview & Entity Information

- **Institute Name**: Takshasheela School of Civil Services
- **Former Name**: Takshashila School of Civil Services
- **Parent Company / Trust**: Takshashila Educational Trust
- **Mission**: To educate, train, and mentor young aspirants in Assam and the North-Eastern region to succeed in India's tough civil services examinations.
- **Faculty Strength**: Experienced faculties and mentors from Delhi and across India with 5 to 20+ years of teaching experience.
- **Facilities**: State-of-the-art smart classrooms, advanced library, online recorded lecture access, comprehensive study materials, and one-on-one personal mentorship.
- **Location**: 6th Floor, Unique Avenue Building, Bus Stand, GS Rd, near Super Market, Bormotoria, Guwahati, Assam 781006, India.

---

## 2. Core Courses & Academic Offerings

### A. UPSC Civil Services Examination (CSE) Package
- **Target Exams**: IAS, IPS, IFS, IRS, and central civil services.
- **Duration**: 9–10 months of intensive coaching.
- **Modes**: Available in both **Offline** (Guwahati center) and **Online** modes.
- **Coverage**: Complete syllabus coverage for Prelims (GS Paper I & CSAT), Mains (GS Papers I-IV, Essay), and Personality Test (Interview).
- **Features**:
  - Full study materials (printed & digital)
  - Prelims & Mains test series with detailed evaluations and model answers
  - Daily & weekly mains answer writing practice
  - Personal mentorship and progress tracking
  - DAF-based mock interviews with active/retired civil servants
  - Flexible installment payment plans available

### B. APSC Combined Competitive Examination (CCE) Package
- **Target Exams**: ACS (Assam Civil Service), APS (Assam Police Service), and allied state services.
- **Duration**: 9–10 months.
- **Modes**: **Offline** and **Online** batches, as well as a specialized **Weekend Batch** tailored for working professionals.
- **Assam-Specific Focus**: Deep integration of Assam History, Geography, Polity, Culture, Economy, and Assam Tribune current affairs analysis.
- **Features**:
  - Assam Yearbook coverage and state-specific study modules
  - Full syllabus coverage aligned with the latest APSC CCE examination pattern
  - Scheduled prelims & mains mock tests with personalized feedback
  - Recorded lecture backup for all missed sessions

### C. ADRE 2026 Batch (Assam Direct Recruitment Examination)
- **Target Exam**: SLRC Class III and Class IV posts in Assam Government.
- **Mode**: 100% Online Coaching.
- **Pricing**: Starting from ₹999 / ₹1999 with flexible access.
- **Coverage**: Complete syllabus for HSLC, HSSLC, and Graduate-level posts including Mathematics, Reasoning, English, General Knowledge, and Assam GK.
